mapper.sql: SELECT m.id, m.mentor_name, m.mentor_phone, m.dept_id, m.position_id, m.title, m.status, m.remark, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.deleted, d.dept_name, p.position_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u WHERE u.del_flag = '0' AND u.mentor_id = m.id) AS intern_count FROM mentor m LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = m.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN position p ON p.id = m.position_id AND p.deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT m.id, m.mentor_name, m.mentor_phone, m.dept_id, m.title, m.status, d.dept_name, m.position_id FROM mentor m LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = m.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0'
m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = '0'
AND m.dept_id = #{scopeDeptId}
ORDER BY m.dept_id ASC, m.id ASC
